column2: 12.  The  seal  of  the  Corporation  shall  not  be  affixed  to
any  instrument  whatsoever  except  in  the  presence  of  the
President  and  the  Secretary  or  two  other  members  of  the
Corporation  as  may  be  decided  by  the  Committee  of
Management who shall sign their names to the instrument
in  token  of  their  presence  and  such    signing  shall  be
independent of the signing  of any person as a witness.

13.
Nothing  in  this  Act  contained  shall  prejudice  or
affect  the  rights  of  the  Republic  or  of  any  body  politic,
or  corporate, or of any other persons.
